peopleAlsoAsk.question: Does temperature affect alginate?

Water quality showed minimal impact under study conditions. These findings support implementing temperature control protocols for optimizing alginate working time in clinical practice.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: Can you freeze sodium alginate?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Pharmaceutical products containing sodium alginate are sometimes subjected to temperatures below freezing during storage or shipping. Freezing of sodium alginate solutions results in a viscosity increase which may impair their usefulness.
